snippet.title: Voyage Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
⚓ Play the game here: https://storbeed.itch.io/voyage

Voyage is psychological horror about maintaining a fishing boat in the middle of nowhere. You're a fledgling fisherman, just sent on your first voyage. Your duties are simple: maintain the boat, complete tasks, and perhaps uncover the truth about yourself along the way. Horror game about maintaining a fishing boat in the middle of nowhere. (40-60 min playtime). 

Join our Discord for backstage content: https://discord.gg/jbb7NhcAqG
